function.name: request_photo
function.description: Send the caller a WhatsApp message asking for a photo of their plumbing problem. Call this early in the call, as soon as the caller describes an issue. After calling it, keep the conversation going; a system message with the photo diagnosis and price range will arrive automatically when the photo comes in.

function.name: book_appointment
function.description: Book a plumber visit once the caller agrees. Collect their name, full address, and preferred time first. This also notifies the plumber.

time.description: Requested appointment date and time, e.g. 'Tomorrow 10am' or '2026-11-10 14:00'

issue.description: Short description of the plumbing problem
